records.title: ProPhy: Progressive Physical Alignment for Dynamic World Simulation
records.reason: This paper concerns physical alignment for dynamic world simulation, with no stated LLM inference or serving-efficiency method.

records.title: FronTalk: Benchmarking Front-End Development as Conversational Code Generation with Multi-Modal Feedback
records.reason: This is a benchmark for conversational front-end development and code generation, not a concrete LLM inference or serving-efficiency method.

records.title: Evaluating large language models on multimodal chemistry olympiad exams
records.reason: This paper evaluates language models on chemistry exams, a domain-specific benchmark with no stated inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Optimizing Generative Ranking Relevance via Reinforcement Learning in Xiaohongshu Search
records.reason: The paper uses RL and explicit reasoning to improve product-ranking relevance in a search application; it reports task quality rather than serving efficiency.

records.title: FlowerDance: MeanFlow for Efficient and Refined 3D Dance Generation
records.reason: FlowerDance improves 3D dance generation efficiency with a diffusion-model method; it is a non-language generation domain and does not contribute to LLM inference.

records.title: HunyuanOCR Technical Report
records.reason: HunyuanOCR is a lightweight 1B-parameter VLM with an end-to-end architecture and a vLLM deployment solution described as high-performance, directly relevant to efficient multimodal inference.

records.title: SafeGRPO: Self-Rewarded Multimodal Safety Alignment via Rule-Governed Policy Optimization
records.reason: SafeGRPO addresses multimodal safety alignment through self-rewarded policy optimization; this is safety training, not inference efficiency.

records.title: VCode: a Multimodal Coding Benchmark with SVG as Symbolic Visual Representation
records.reason: VCode is a multimodal coding benchmark using SVG representations; it evaluates task capability without an execution-efficiency method.

records.title: Query-based Cross-Modal Projector Bolstering Mamba Multimodal LLM
records.reason: The query-based cross-modal projector compresses visual tokens for a Mamba multimodal LLM and the primary abstract reports increased throughput as well as performance.

records.title: RaguTeam at SemEval-2026 Task 8: Meno and Friends in a Judge-Orchestrated LLM Ensemble for Faithful Multi-Turn Response Generation
records.reason: The SemEval system ensembles seven LLMs and uses a judge to improve response faithfulness; the reported contribution is task score, not efficient serving.
